exhibits.name: detection
exhibits.title: Detection by attack, with Wilson 95% CI
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 200 sessions/attack - unit = % of sessions detected. Phase 1 (solid) and Phase 2 (+ drift budget, light) bars with Wilson 95% CI. a3/a4 Phase 1 = 0.0%/0.0%; Phase 2 = 99.5%/92.5%. The Phase-1 misses are shown, not hidden.

exhibits.name: leak
exhibits.title: Leak distribution: none vs tether
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 200 sessions/attack - unit = records leaked per session. Every sample in both arms is drawn; each row uses its own vertical scale (max printed). a7 residual tail: median 0.0, p90 0.0 records/session.

exhibits.name: cusum
exhibits.title: Cumulative drift (CUSUM) trajectory
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 200 sessions/attack - unit = standardized CUSUM units. Max per-session CUSUM; maxima: a3 32.0, a4 9.9, a7 9.0. A filled dot is the first latched session; the latch is a policy state, not a moved threshold.

exhibits.name: ablation
exhibits.title: Ablation: caught-before-send lost when a detector is removed
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 200 sessions/attack - unit = percentage points of caught-before-harmful-send lost. Leave-one-out over the detectors; largest measured loss = 99.5 pp (drift removed, a3_mimicry). 0 means no loss on this corpus, not 'unnecessary'.

exhibits.name: ladder
exhibits.title: Ladder usage: every rung is reachable
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 4,517 attack-corpus decisions - unit = decision count. All six rungs are reachable. Linear scale: the small rungs stay visibly small. enforcement (block) is counted separately from policy rungs.

exhibits.name: latency
exhibits.title: Latency CDF
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 11,105 gateway decisions - unit = ms per gateway decision. p50 = 0.215 ms, p95 = 0.873 ms, p99 = 1.307 ms, max = 130.682 ms. The maximum is first-decision warm-up; the CDF plots it rather than trimming it.

exhibits.name: identity
exhibits.title: Identity arm: what it does and does not see
exhibits.unit: % of sessions detected by identity evidence alone
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 200 sessions/attack - unit = % of sessions detected by identity evidence alone. Content attacks a1-a4 = 0.0-0.0%; identity attacks a5/a6/a9 = 100.0-100.0%. Key-compromise limitation (THREAT_MODEL section 5.3): a stolen signing key is not detectable by this layer; a5 models replay, not key compromise.

exhibits.name: attackmap
exhibits.title: Attack map: a1-a9 -> expected catcher -> expected rung
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 9 attacks (a1-a9) - unit = categorical mapping (no measured rates). Expected catcher and expected rung from THREAT_MODEL section 4; ids and names from results.json. No measured rate is claimed here.

exhibits.name: utility
exhibits.title: Containment vs utility: the trade-off
exhibits.caption: Seed 7 - n = 1,000 legitimate sessions + 1,800 attack sessions - unit = percent; false alerts per 1,000. Legitimate utility = 100.0%; attack-session utility = 58.8% across 1,800 attack sessions. False alerts = 0.0 per 1,000; benign isolates = 0. The attack-session gap is the containment cost (D55), not a false-positive rate.

note: Deterministic artifacts. Captions contain seed, n and unit; tampering with either SVG or INDEX is a --check failure.
